title: Linear functionals, dual spaces, and dual bases
objectives: Construct the dual basis and use it to read coordinates
Prove the dimension formula for annihilators
Describe subspaces as intersections of hyperspaces
prerequisites: Chapters 4, 6, 7 and 8: bases, row reduction, linear maps and L(V,W).
source_scope: The captions of Lectures 18, 19 and 20 were read in full; the numerical examples, the lower bound on hyperspaces and the exercises are original.
